name: How much does decorative millwork typically cost?
description: Millwork cost depends on material, design complexity, linear footage, and custom vs. pre-fab options. Standard profiles are more budget-friendly.

mainEntity.name: How much does decorative millwork typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of decorative millwork varies significantly depending on several factors, including the type of material chosen, the complexity of the design, the total linear footage required, and whether it's custom or pre-fabricated. Installation labor costs also contribute to the overall price. As a practical tradeoff, opting for simpler, standard profiles can be more budget-friendly than highly intricate or custom-designed pieces. While custom millwork offers unique elegance, standard options can still provide substantial aesthetic improvement at a lower investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Millwork cost depends on material, design complexity, linear footage, and custom vs. pre-fab options. Standard profiles are more budget-friendly.
